description: This file defines the HashBasedPlacementDirector class, which implements the IPlacementDirector interface to determine the placement of grains in Orleans runtime based on hashing. It contains logic to select a suitable silo for activation, considering placement hints and deterministic hashing.

classes.name: HashBasedPlacementDirector
classes.description: Implements placement logic for grains based on hashing, ensuring deterministic silo selection.

methods.name: OnAddActivation
methods.description: Determines the silo for activating a grain, using placement hints or hashing for deterministic placement.
